summary: Konami's 1988 arcade driving game about escaping across a border in a bomb-rigged Porsche 959 while dodging military obstacles.

entries.title: Hot Chase

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Hot Chase is sourced as a 1988 Konami arcade driving game with Arcade as its listed platform and no documented home ports or alternate content routes. It is similar to Chase H.Q. in play style, but it is a distinct Konami game and not a Chase H.Q. series entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original arcade version in MAME/original hardware.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform route; no secondary content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate Hot Chase with Taito's Chase H.Q.; no sourced port or remaster is listed.
